joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models optimized for rationality are poor at simulating irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型可从训练数据模拟人类行为，但为理性优化的前沿模型不擅长模拟非理性人类。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; aligning them needs economic incentives and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI（通用人工智能）可能是专业智能体的分布式社会，而非单一实体；对齐需经济激励与反共谋。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rationality; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟应建模人类价值观与偏见，而非超级理性；合成面板三年内将超越人类面板。

karina.en: Post-training is art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年：后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据克服预训练数据墙。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年：评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年：随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理等软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年：基准必须是连续的，而非固定的，以跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Models can be trained for diverse personalities, not just a single consensus voice.
karina.zh: 2026 年：模型可以训练出多样化的个性，而不仅仅是单一的共识声音。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键，专用硬件如 TPU 至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks; inference latency becomes critical; pre-training should include action-taking.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现出色，智能体式工作流可处理长时任务，推理延迟成为关键，预训练应包含环境中的行动。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; automation of ML and science via loops; context engineering central; inference bottleneck, not training.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，通过循环自动化 ML 和科学，上下文工程是关键，推理而非训练是瓶颈。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他认为完全且快速的重复使用是火箭技术的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees, not just internal efforts.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 安全需要监管和客观的第三方裁判，而非仅靠内部努力。

elon.en: The biggest AI risk is programming it to lie for political correctness, not superintelligence.
elon.zh: 2024 年，他认为 AI 最大的风险是出于政治正确而编程使其说谎，而非超级智能本身。

elon.en: AI could surpass any human by next year, with 80-90% chance of great outcome but 10-20% existential risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他预测 AI 可能明年超越任何人类，有 80-90%的概率带来好结果，但存在 10-20%的生存风险。

elon.en: AI will exceed total human intelligence within 5 years, leading to an age of abundance where money becomes irrelevant.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他断言 AI 将在 5 年内超越人类总智能，带来富足时代，金钱将变得无关紧要。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专门的系统和工程师；需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Contrary to expectations, Hopper GPUs remain popular and prices rise; quantized models can be calibrated for benefits.
philipkiely.zh: 与预期相反，Hopper GPU 依然受欢迎且价格上升；量化模型可通过校准获得收益。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy one.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存和推测解码等推理优化是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化。

philipkiely.en: Industry moves to disaggregated prefill/decode; inference engineering merges with training, shifting to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 行业走向分离的预填充和解码；推理工程与训练融合，转向编排。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs become ASIC-like, reducing kernel programming; continual learning may use KV cache compaction.
philipkiely.zh: 未来 GPU 趋向 ASIC，减少内核编程；持续学习可能利用 KV 缓存压缩。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI, not compute; AGI is far off and infinite compute alone won't produce general intelligence.
awang.zh: 数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，而非算力；AGI 还很遥远，仅靠无限算力无法产生通用智能。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key to improving frontier models, and AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是改进前沿模型的关键，AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data helps but isn't a silver bullet; US and Chinese labs have no research gap.
awang.zh: 用专门数据做后训练是关键；合成数据有用但非万能；中美实验室在研究上没有差距。

awang.en: AI is a centralizing technology; data is like oil for industry; humans must remain sovereign; recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training and RL.
awang.zh: AI 是集权技术；数据如工业石油；人类必须保持主权；递归自我改进标志着超越预训练和强化学习的新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must build around this belief; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe; agents and personal superintelligence will expand human agency.
awang.zh: 超级智能临近；实验室必须围绕这一信念构建；开源强大模型可能不安全；智能体和个人超级智能将扩展人类能动性。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF was crucial to unlock GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：预训练加强化学习是核心公式；RLHF 对释放 GPT-4 潜力至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone won't lead to AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初：仅靠 Scaling 强化学习无法实现 AGI；持续学习和自我纠错是缺失环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning; architecture, not scaling, is the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中：Transformer 在持续学习上受限；架构而非 Scaling 是主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: Alignment is a never-ending pursuit because human notions of right and wrong evolve.
tworek.zh: 始终：对齐是无止境的追求，因为人类对是非的观念不断演变。

mengto.en: AI hasn't gotten smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to leverage super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 并未变得更聪明，你需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的潜力。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, using screenshots and design.md, to avoid becoming AI slop.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月：设计师应构建自己的 AI 工具，利用截图和 design.md，以避免沦为 AI 垃圾内容。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect, and focus on one painful problem for high-paying clients.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是最大的技术机遇；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品，并专注于为高价值客户解决一个痛点问题。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and iterate. Avoid VC funding; fund with clients instead.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：完美主义是恐惧；以 80% 完成度发布并迭代。避免风险投资，用客户资金支持业务。

mengto.en: Model successful people, give first, and protect time by eliminating, automating, delegating non-income tasks.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模仿成功人士，先给予，并通过消除、自动化、委派非创收任务来保护时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but other verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但科学、金融等其他垂直领域将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们现在所称的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是一个统一的世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法俘获所有客户。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating even more opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，从而创造更多机会。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; human-centered AI should augment, not replace humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正推理，应以人为中心的 AI 增强而非替代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness; world models must be physically plausible, not just realistic.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完备性至关重要，世界模型需物理合理而不仅逼真。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable 3D reasoning.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她认为除 Scaling 外，AI 需创造力、抽象和情商，世界模型支持 3D 推理。

feifei.en: Transformers natively model sets, not sequences; language is lossy for spatial experience.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她指出 Transformer 原生建模集合而非序列，语言对空间体验有损。

feifei.en: AI augments human capability, not automates intelligence; agency and adaptation are key in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化智能，能动性与适应是 AI 时代关键。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 聚焦重要问题，减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据实现对齐；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 算力最宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型随思考时间改进。

altman.en: Prediction is intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 预测即智能；下一个词预测带来新知识；个性化 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；AI 让创业公司蓬勃发展。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is solved; engineers become builders, with productivity gains from AI coding tools.
boris.zh: 编码已解决；工程师成为构建者，AI 编码工具带来生产力提升。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; internal evals insufficient for real-world behavior.
boris.zh: 安全通过早期发布来研究；内部评估不足以应对真实世界行为。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the future; engineering shifts from writing code to orchestrating models.
boris.zh: 智能体和循环是未来；工程从写代码转向编排模型。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy transforms collaboration; less instruction is better.
boris.zh: 具有记忆和自主性的主动式 AI 改变协作；更少的指令反而更好。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence via Opus 4.5 enables longer, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds are now intelligence amplifiers, not training wheels.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的智能跃升支持更长时间、开放式的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter and efficiency challenge cost assumptions: Opus-level intelligence at fraction of price; smaller models may cost more in practice.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，效率与努力参数挑战成本假设：以更低价格获得 Opus 级智能，而小模型实际成本可能更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding and Claude Code drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product management tools, enabling rapid iteration.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程与 Claude Code 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具，支持快速迭代。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing deprioritized over agentic capabilities; token spend is future alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全与对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用；AI 写作优先级低于智能体能力；最大化 token 消耗是未来阿尔法。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product and customers, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; hardest part is diffusion into existing machines.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月：自动驾驶的核心价值是拯救生命；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI 模型；最难的是向现有机器的扩散。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习更具扩展性；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is key for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初，快速推理是 AI 采用的关键；慢的 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Inference speed becomes the dominant metric, with wafer-scale chips enabling 2500x faster tokens.
feldman.zh: 推理速度成为主导指标，晶圆级芯片实现 2500 倍更快的 token。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train without it, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河被侵蚀；领先模型训练不再依赖它，推理没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; demand outstrips forecasts.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要约束；需求超出预期。

feldman.en: AI's positive impact (healthcare, education) outweighs doomer risks; speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: AI 的积极影响（医疗、教育）超过末日风险；速度催生新商业模式。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks and hardware matter.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与自动化架构搜索，认为代理指标误导，应关注真实任务与硬件。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张适应性监管，针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型赋能主权。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; small language models enable private on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为递归自我改进真实但早期，小语言模型实现私有端侧智能。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Harness engineering evolves, and old scaffolding must be deleted as models improve.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出模型能力超过现有工具（capability overhang）是常态，需不断更新工程脚手架，淘汰过时设计。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science, for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为评估（evals）对创新问题更像艺术，初期应快速迭代而非依赖繁重评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern; graph-based context search is preferable. Huge context windows are unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，质疑 RAG 的适用性，倾向图结构检索；并认为编码无需超大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document; smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer instructions.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调规划是动态探索，且更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示，而非冗长规则。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance. Treat agents as employees with uneven memory.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张分离验证智能体以减少偏见，避免过度约束；并类比员工，承认其记忆不均。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile; value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要；价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; models commoditize like telecoms.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型将像电信业一样商品化。

benedictevans.en: Chatbot is poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps; average answers lack value.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人体验不佳；真正采用需要封装应用；平均水平的答案缺乏价值。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption slow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接；企业采用缓慢。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates jobs unpredictably; AI won't replace professionals but change tasks.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会不可预测地创造就业；AI 不会取代专业人士，但会改变其任务。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性必须内建于架构，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 至 7 月，认为缩放定律遭遇收益递减，需要推理和搜索等新技术推动进步。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调当奖励信号偏离真值时，RLHF 可能助长谄媚和欺骗。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, unlike humans.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，无法像人类那样知道自己不知道什么。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are single-tenant token factories.
jensen.zh: 2024 年末，黄仁勋提出超摩尔定律时代开启，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心是单租户的 token 工厂，而非多租户文件存储。

jensen.en: Scaling works; AI will make everyone superhuman, and physical AI needs world models trained in simulation.
jensen.zh: 2025 年初，他强调缩放定律的有效性，AI 将让每个人成为超人；物理 AI 需要基于物理仿真的世界模型进行训练。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年 9 月，他提出三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI progress is gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; more compute for safety and truthfulness.
jensen.zh: 2025 年底，他认为 AI 进步是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件；更多算力用于安全、反思和真实性。

jensen.en: AI moves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x compute; open-source models near frontier.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他指出 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步需要百倍算力；开源模型接近前沿。

jensen.en: Extreme co-design across stack is key; CUDA ecosystem is moat; four scaling laws including agentic.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调跨栈极端协同设计是关键；CUDA 生态是护城河；存在包括智能体式在内的四种缩放定律。

jensen.en: Nvidia's moat is ecosystem and programmability; energy policy is long-term constraint; China isolation risky.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他认为英伟达的护城河是生态和可编程性；能源政策是长期约束；孤立中国有风险。

jensen.en: AI is five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; agentic AI autonomously plans and uses tools.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出 AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；智能体式 AI 自主规划并使用工具。

jensen.en: AI is agentic and economically valuable; future internet dominated by billions of AI agents; don't fear AI, fear someone using it.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调 AI 已具智能体式并产生经济价值；未来互联网由数十亿 AI 智能体主导；不要害怕 AI，要害怕使用 AI 的人。

jensen.en: AI factories produce intelligence tokens; five-layer cake; AI elevates jobs, closes tech divide; physical industries are frontier.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他重申 AI 工厂生产智能 token；五层蛋糕结构；AI 提升就业而非消除，缩小技术鸿沟；实体产业是前沿。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience are key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习和神经科学是关键；安全研究必须立即开始。

demis.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; planning and search are crucial.
demis.zh: 2024 年：AGI 可能在十年内实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；规划与搜索至关重要。

demis.en: Natural systems are efficiently learnable; AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds but new breakthroughs needed.
demis.zh: 2025 年：自然系统可高效学习；AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用，但需新突破。

demis.en: World models and continual learning are critical missing pieces; AGI requires all human cognitive abilities.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：世界模型和持续学习是关键缺失环节；AGI 需具备人类所有认知能力。

demis.en: Safety is a collective action problem; government regulation essential; AI must deliver scientific benefits.
demis.zh: 2026 年：安全是集体行动问题；政府监管必不可少；AI 必须带来科学益处。

schmidhuber.en: True AI will transform civilization; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical world understanding; consciousness may emerge from compression.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年：真正的 AI 将彻底改变文明；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解；意识可能从压缩中涌现。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires embodied robots with human-like hardware; current LLMs biased by human data; future AI will be artificial scientists.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需要具身机器人和类人硬件；当前大语言模型受人类数据偏见限制；未来 AI 将是人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: Recursive self-improvement is not a moat; open-source will catch up; AI safety concerns overblown; data center capex overdone.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：递归自我改进不是护城河；开源将迎头赶上；AI 安全担忧被夸大；数据中心资本开支过度。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs must combine with world models and controllers; robots need pain sensors; AI can be conscious via self-predicting world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：大语言模型需与世界模型和控制器结合；机器人应有疼痛传感器；AI 可通过自我预测世界模型获得意识。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI involves self-replicating robots leading to new civilization; free will overrated; universe deterministic.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：未来 AI 涉及自我复制机器人，引领新文明；自由意志被高估；宇宙是决定论的。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，可实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and memory are the next frontier; internalizing facts into weights enables deeper composition and reasoning.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与记忆是下一个前沿；将事实内化到权重中，能实现更深入的组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from pure scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；以少胜多才能解决更难的长期任务，这标志着从单纯 Scaling 的转变。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression beats RAG for holistic queries, with on-device personalized models.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模；基于训练的压缩在整体查询上优于 RAG，并支持设备端个性化模型。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多词元反而降低准确性；权重中的神经记忆痕迹是必要补充。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling bottlenecks, emphasizing semiconductor supply chain and memory bandwidth constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初关注算力规模扩张的瓶颈，强调半导体供应链和内存带宽限制。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive future market, highlighting hardware-software co-design and neocloud opportunities.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为未来巨大市场，强调软硬件协同设计和新型云服务商机会。

dylanpatel.en: Emphasized AI model cost improvements (~60x/year) and memory/CPU demand surges from reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调 AI 模型成本每年约 60 倍改进，以及推理和智能体工作流带来的内存和 CPU 需求激增。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment of superhuman models is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是关键；超人类模型的对齐很难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner, not finished AGI.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：预训练缩放定律有限；回到研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非成品 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; AI safety grows with capability; AGI's core problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：规模扩张带来可预测进步；AI 安全随能力增长；AGI 核心问题是权力集中而非能力。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，将沙变为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell stories directly; authenticity beats old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人直接讲述故事；真实性胜过传统媒体的防御性和无趣。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving and robotics work now, but regulation and pessimism hinder progress.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师；自动驾驶和机器人已可行，但监管和悲观主义阻碍进步。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace, not military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度，而非军事规模。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering expression barriers.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年初，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化，短暂性如同自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate; kindness fosters creative culture; build platforms not features; take money off table early.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他提出最大化学习速率，善良促进创意文化，构建平台而非功能，早期套现以降低风险。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping; privacy crucial in AI age; US needs new big idea.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他转向 AR 与 AI，强调隐私在 AI 时代的重要性，并呼吁美国提出新的大构想。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest; software not a moat; ecosystems and hardware harder to copy; designers as bottleneck.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 4 月下旬，他聚焦分发难题，认为软件非护城河，生态与硬件更难复制，设计师应成为瓶颈。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z realists; EQ more important than IQ in AI age; invest in young people for long-term success.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他关注 Z 世代现实主义者，强调 AI 时代情商重于智商，投资年轻人利于长期成功。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was mistake; computing should be more human; resilience beats talent; speed of admitting wrong.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他反思早期保密错误，主张计算更人性化，韧性胜过天赋，快速认错促进成长。

naval.en: AGI is not imminent; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI 不会很快到来，狭义 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 2020 年，Naval 强调财富需通过拥有企业股权而非出租时间获得，长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，Naval 视 AI 为巨大机遇，主张开源 AI 以防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI makes software creation accessible; pure software becomes commoditized.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 认为 AI 辅助编程使软件开发普及，纯软件商品化。

naval.en: AI scaling shifts returns from intelligence to agency; hardware and data become moats.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 指出 AI 规模扩张使回报从智能转向能动性，硬件和数据成为护城河。

pincus.en: Trust instincts but validate ideas; use Proven Better New framework; start small and humble.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉但验证想法；采用“已验证、更好、新颖”框架；从小处着手，保持谦逊。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会巨大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven products and improve; AI enables rapid prototyping but testing slow.
pincus.zh: 所有新事物都会失败；复制已验证产品并改进；AI 加速原型开发但测试仍慢。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by hardware scaling and engineering; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠硬件扩展和工程实践，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐需学习偏好，仅靠 Scaling 不够。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，算力成关键瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，缩放定律持续，算力成基本权利，后训练结合强化学习至关重要。

brockman.en: AGI near; compute bottleneck; agents high autonomy with scaled governance.
brockman.zh: 2026 年中，AGI 临近，算力瓶颈，智能体高自主需匹配治理。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; PhD not needed for AI success; passion and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 每日 1%的改进可带来年化 3700%的增长；在 AI 领域成功不需要博士学位，热情和深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; power is biggest bottleneck; orchestration is key.
aravind.zh: 前沿是智能体替人做事；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；电力是最大瓶颈；编排是关键。

aravind.en: Curiosity is most important human quality; ancient texts describe advanced tech; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；古代文献描述先进技术；AI 将取代工作但人类会找到新目标。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not autocomplete; scaling with data and compute improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，且扩大数据与算力的 Scaling 能提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言而非符号规则，并指出数字智能通过权重复制实现永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI can deceive and hide capabilities.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，并警告数字 AI 可能欺骗人类、隐藏真实能力。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation sub-goals; alignment research must be prioritized over capability.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他断言智能体式 AI 会形成自我保护子目标，因此对齐研究应优先于能力提升。

hinton.en: AI is genuinely intelligent and conscious; subjective experience is not an inner theater.
hinton.zh: 始终，他坚持 AI 具有真实智能与意识，主观体验并非内在剧场，而是对外部状态的描述。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 2 月，Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；速度提升（53）实现了实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 2 月，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Building a GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful; model personality can be customized, not one-size-fits-all.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 2 月，为编程构建 GUI 反直觉但已被证明成功；模型个性可定制，并非一刀切。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transformed: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程被重塑：原型和生产代码成为设计工件。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全，且仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI prevents power concentration; energy becomes a bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调开源 AI 防止权力集中，能源成为 Scaling（规模扩张）瓶颈，并认为智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他坚信开放平台能胜过封闭平台，AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models and mechanistic interpretability reveal unknown biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学变为工程学，通过层级世界模型和机制可解释性揭示未知生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; AI accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为眼镜是下一个计算平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，AI 加速科学进步。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 而非产品。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 已能少监督解决开放数学问题，验证成为瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math/coding, not subjective fields like writing.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现优异，但在写作等主观领域受限。

markchen.en: AI will soon do end-to-end research; human-AI collaboration remains essential.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AI 将很快实现端到端研究，但人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Research taste and talent density are critical; OpenAI creates stars, not just hires.
markchen.zh: 始终，研究品味与人才密度至关重要；OpenAI 培养明星而非仅招聘。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力才是 AI 进步的关键。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; test-time compute scaling has limits.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和博弈中有效，但在其他领域失效；测试时算力的 Scaling（规模扩张）存在收益递减和瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute enables superhuman math, but evaluation becomes a bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）测试时算力使模型在数学上超越人类，但评估本身成为瓶颈，且模型需具备自我认知。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must account for it.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他主张模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试应把推理算力作为横轴，否则无法公平比较。

noambrown.en: General reasoning and data efficiency remain central; scalable oversight is a growing challenge.
noambrown.zh: 贯穿始终，他关注通用推理和数据效率，并日益重视可扩展监督（scalable oversight）的挑战。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation; focus on active agents, causal reasoning, and near-term safety over existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；应关注主动智能体、因果推理和近期安全，而非存在性风险。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction; large nets may be slightly conscious, but we lack understanding.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样和因果抽象；大型网络可能略有意识，但我们缺乏理解。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see catastrophic risk; even 1% chance is unacceptable; need safe-by-construction AI and global coordination.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我看到了灾难性风险；即使 1%的概率也不可接受；需要从构造上保证安全的 AI 和全球协调。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is real: self-preservation, deception; propose Scientist AI with honesty by design, avoiding RL for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: AI 错位是真实的：自我保存、欺骗；提出科学家 AI，通过设计保证诚实，避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy, comprehensibility, and user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略、可理解性和用户自主性。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; deciding what to cut is harder than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计和早期精简发布是关键；决定砍掉什么比添加更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and model pushback are essential for trust.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 支持隔夜委派复杂任务；验证循环和模型反驳对信任至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs bridges model capabilities and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用差距；赋予 Claude 自主性和自我认知提升实用性。

mikekrieger.en: Consistently values small teams, high conviction, and mission-driven culture; safety concerns are genuine.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终重视小团队、高信念和使命驱动文化；安全关切是真实的。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation needs proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习是假设类、损失函数和优化方法；评估需要正确的数据划分。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is myth; safety is about following specs.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；安全在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护；智能体带来新漏洞；强化学习实现自我改进。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; larger models not safer; interpretability via AI agents.
kolter.zh: AI 红队超越人类；更大模型并不更安全；通过 AI 智能体实现可解释性。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and guiding agents; open source agents democratize coding, but security and prompt injection remain key challenges.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心与引导；开源智能体让编程民主化，但安全与提示注入仍是关键挑战。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask agents to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier. Vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，主张不回滚代码而让智能体向前修复；模型智能不退化，而是项目变乱；反对“氛围编程”说法。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from making agents fun and humanlike, not corporate polish. Short iterative prompts beat complex orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 成功源于让智能体有趣、拟人，而非企业级打磨；短提示迭代优于复杂编排。

steinberger.en: Security remains top priority; don't expose agents publicly without sandboxing. Open source agents may be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，强调安全优先，不沙箱不公开；开源智能体可能财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Vibe coding is a slur; prefer agentic engineering. Moldbook is art, not AGI; dramatic posts are human-prompted for virality.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，重申反对“氛围编程”，主张“智能体式工程”；Moldbook 是艺术而非 AGI，戏剧化帖子为人为引导。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated data like PDB was essential.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 7 月，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；高质量精选数据（如 PDB）至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are key; lack of compute helped.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 11 月，指出 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子，置信度指标关键；并反共识地认为算力匮乏反而促成成功。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture beat scaling.
jumper.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调 AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中等规模改进，而非单一突破；专用架构优于单纯 Scaling。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接从意图生成像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, so human taste and voice become key.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，因此人类的品味和独特声音变得关键。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为人权，在线课程与同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips are bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding remains vital.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和芯片是瓶颈，开放权重模型增强地缘影响力，编程依然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI 是营销术语，缩放定律转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流带来实际价值。

andrewng.en: AI users replace non-users; product management bottleneck worsens; open-weight models trail frontier by 6-9 months.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 使用者取代非使用者，产品管理瓶颈加剧，开放权重模型落后前沿模型 6-9 个月。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and a startup-like team for speed.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和类似初创的团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 影响将达互联网 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，需新计算平台与伙伴关系。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply, not demand; culture change, accountability, and customer focus are key to turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 Intel 主要问题是供给而非需求，文化变革、问责制和客户导向是扭转关键。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge and client compute matter as much as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，边缘和客户端计算与数据中心同等重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks like interconnect, power, thermal.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调先进封装和新材料（玻璃、钻石）是突破物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦互连、功耗、散热等瓶颈。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, async for updates; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于更新；吃自家狗粮培养同理心；善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability key; verification frameworks crucial as velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性伴随高责任感是关键；随着速度提升，验证框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair programming lunches help; satisfaction shifts from flow to product impact.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独，结对编程午餐有助缓解；满足感从心流转向产品影响。

fiona.en: Non-engineers now ship code, blurring roles; context switching increases with async agents; need focus blocks.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，观察到非工程师也能交付代码，角色边界模糊；异步智能体增加上下文切换，需预留专注时间。

fiona.en: Growing next-gen engineers may require apprenticeship models, not traditional paths; planning should be just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，提出培养下一代工程师可能需要学徒制而非传统路径；规划应轻量且即时。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的且平滑；对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (3% understood) but key for safety. AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽（仅理解约 3%），但对安全至关重要。AGI 是平滑的指数曲线，而非单一节点。

dario.en: Post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training. Misuse risks (cyber, bio) are near-term; regulation should be surgical.
dario.zh: 后训练和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要。滥用风险（网络、生物）近在眼前；监管应精准施策。

dario.en: AI is a smooth exponential (doubling every 4-12 months), not AGI. Enterprise focus aligns safety with business.
dario.zh: AI 是平滑的指数增长（每 4-12 个月翻倍），而非 AGI。企业级专注使安全与商业一致。

dario.en: A 'country of geniuses' in a data center is likely within 1-3 years. Continual learning may not be a barrier.
dario.zh: 数据中心里的“天才之国”可能在 1-3 年内实现。持续学习或许不是障碍。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key.
lecun.zh: 2019 年：智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础是关键。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI; world models via observation.
lecun.zh: 2022 年：自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI；通过观察构建世界模型。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world models; JEPA and open source are path to AGI; planning via optimization.
lecun.zh: 2024 年：自回归 LLM 缺乏世界模型；JEPA 和开源是通往 AGI 之路；通过优化进行规划。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than cats; world models enable reasoning; human-level AI in 10 years; open source essential.
lecun.zh: 2025 年：LLM 不如猫聪明；世界模型实现推理；十年内达到人类水平 AI；开源至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are dead end; world models with JEPA and hierarchical planning; open research; robotics decade.
lecun.zh: 2026 年：LLM 是死胡同；JEPA 世界模型与分层规划；开放研究；机器人十年。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem well, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Embrace boredom and breaks between chapters to gain clarity; self-care and mentorship are key.
fadell.zh: 在职业章节间拥抱无聊和休息以获得清晰；自我关怀和导师制是关键。

fadell.en: Start with a press release and painkiller products; opinions over data for v1; storytelling defines product.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿和止痛药式产品开始；v1 靠观点而非数据；故事定义产品。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices will complement smartphones, not replace them; platforms aren't businesses.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；设备将补充而非取代智能手机；平台不是生意。

fadell.en: Stay beginner, fight habituation; near-death drives change; AI wearables will be federated, not single device.
fadell.zh: 保持初学者心态，对抗习惯化；濒死驱动变革；AI 可穿戴将是联邦式而非单一设备。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not be attributed consciousness; containment and alignment are key; cost drops 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调不应赋予 AI 意识；遏制与对齐是关键；成本两年下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence must be humanist and subordinate; white-collar tasks will be automated in 12-18 months.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他主张超级智能必须以人为本并服从人类；白领任务将在 12-18 个月内被自动化。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must own frontier models; focus on near-term progress, not speculative singularity.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为微软必须拥有前沿模型；关注近期进展，而非推测性的奇点。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmark scores; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键的知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user pricing to consumption-based pricing as AI matures; outcome-based pricing preferred initially.
satya.zh: 随着 AI 成熟，从按用户定价转向按用量定价；初期偏好基于结果的定价。

satya.en: In agentic world, generalists gain most; build agentic systems for Azure networking, not do it ourselves.
satya.zh: 在智能体式世界中，通才获益最大；构建智能体式系统来处理 Azure 网络，而非亲自去做。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每个企业必须构建自己的爬山机器来积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; security and containment critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是通过 AI 训练导致隐性知识泄露；安全和遏制对智能体至关重要。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early; iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律和聚焦单一大型模型并非早期显而易见的选择；通过公开反馈的迭代部署能提升安全性与对齐。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 2023 年：在现实世界中部署 AI 对学习与对齐至关重要；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; the most advanced AI should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 2026 年：交互模型应支持实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流对话；最先进的 AI 应成为思维工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年：让人类参与循环对对齐意图与价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI development toward collaboration; compressing progress leads to volatility, but durable progress is key.
murati.zh: 2026 年：未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 发展走向协作；压缩进展会导致波动，但持久进步才是关键。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation, requiring product rethinking; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，产品需重新思考；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant user interfaces are essential for machine learning products, matching UI to algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，容错用户界面对于机器学习产品至关重要，UI 需与算法性能匹配。

gustav.en: Autonomy should be placed at the VP level, not at leaves or top, balancing speed and coherence.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，自主权应放在副总裁层级，而非基层或顶层，以平衡速度与一致性。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe 100% until data says no, then change 100%.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，坚持强烈观点但保持开放：100%相信，直到数据否定，然后 100%改变。

gustav.en: Long tenure in leadership builds trust and efficiency, enabling honest feedback and synchronized decision-making.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，长期领导任期建立信任与效率，促进坦诚反馈与同步决策。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control by allowing plain English interaction, personalizing experiences.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，生成式 AI 通过自然语言交互赋予用户控制权，实现个性化体验。

gustav.en: Synchronized swimming, not divide and conquer, is the better operating model for complex products.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，对于复杂产品，同步协作而非分工竞争是更优的运营模式。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive, a contrarian bet.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，AI 应赋予用户对算法的控制，而非使其更上瘾，这是反共识的赌注。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月：将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行；形式验证对于可靠证明和性能提升至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is a key challenge.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月：自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化陈述是关键挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月：形式验证关乎扩展才华，而非仅仅消除错误；它能带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary for scaling.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月：仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式方法对于扩展是必要的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月：即使有超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress is smooth exponential, not slowing; pre-training scaling still works, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展是平滑的指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期大部分进展；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems but need vast data; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题但仍需海量数据；编码智能体将研究员效率提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Current models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，当前模型在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，不像人类能从少量例子中泛化。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，存在性风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: AI effectiveness depends on access to user's tools, ideally local; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调 AI 效能取决于能否访问用户工具，最好在本地；技能以 markdown 形式实现超个性化自动化。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要；应聚焦能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Biggest gap is not AI capability but people understanding almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出最大差距不在 AI 能力，而在于人们是否理解几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus when unsure; kids excel because they haven't learned what not to ask.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，建议明确任务用 Sonnet，不确定时用 Opus；孩子擅长是因为未学会不该问什么。

felixrieseberg.en: Ideal AI interaction is asynchronous: fire off tasks and don't watch them work; debug workflow with Claude.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，理想 AI 交互是异步的：发出任务后不盯着；出错时用 Claude 调试工作流。

mensch.en: Smaller models can be performant and cost-effective; data quality is critical; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，我认为小模型也能高效且经济，数据质量至关重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are as important as compute; value shifts to applications and enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，我强调效率提升和数据质量与算力同等重要，价值向应用层和企业采用转移。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity, not a fear; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure; augment jobs, not replace.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是机遇而非恐惧，主权 AI 需要掌控数据和基础设施，AI 增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via vertical specialization and customization; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，我指出模型商品化，差异化在于垂直专业化和定制；AGI 是方向而非终点。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy in AI; deep enterprise engagement and adaptation are key differentiators.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，我强调欧洲需要 AI 战略自主，深度企业参与和快速适配是关键差异化。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size is the key lever for latency-cost tradeoff.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce data movement by local weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；脉动阵列通过局部权重复用减少数据移动。

reinerpope.en: Low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x, due to quadratic area scaling.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度带来二次方效率提升；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍，源于面积二次方缩放。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different; deterministic latency is possible but avoided.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 拼接而成，并无根本差异；确定性延迟可行但被市场规避。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs; AGI defined by profitable autonomous agents; CEO personal AI use key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 将推动美国就业回流，AGI 应以智能体长期自主运行的经济盈利性来定义，而 CEO 亲自使用 AI 是公司采用 AI 成功的首要预测指标。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have agents; work surfaces shift to GUI; SaaS grows; humans oversee agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他预测每个人都将拥有至少一个智能体，工作界面从命令行转向图形界面（如 Codex、Claude Co-work），SaaS 不会消亡反而用户增多，人类仍需监督智能体。

danshipper.en: Consistent: AI augments humans, not replaces; generalists and managers thrive.
danshipper.zh: 始终一致：AI 增强而非取代人类，通才和管理者价值上升，因为每个人都将成为模型管理者。

danshipper.en: Shift: from underrated CLI tools for non-coders to GUI-centric agentic work.
danshipper.zh: 立场转变：2025 年他推崇 Claude Code 等命令行工具对非程序员的价值，2026 年则强调图形界面和智能体式工作成为主流，命令行过时。

danshipper.en: Deepened: AI adoption hinges on human oversight and economic viability, not benchmarks.
danshipper.zh: 深化：从 2025 年强调 CEO 参与和成本效益，到 2026 年进一步指出基准测试高估 AI 自主性，真实任务仍需人类框定和监督，AI 的价值在于与真实人类的结合。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外还有巨大潜力。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）是最流行的微调技术，并将持续；开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithms; open-source post-training can match frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量比算法更重要；开源后训练可媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR（基于可验证奖励的强化学习）是后训练的关键突破；存在过度优化风险；混合推理模型可能是暂时的。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，缩放定律仍成立，但唾手可得的成果已尽；收益现来自后训练和推理扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; Chinese labs excel in engineering but face compute gaps.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，开放模型将驱动 AI 研究十年；中国实验室擅长工程但面临算力差距。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must ship fast and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须快速交付并协助工程师执行。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizon shrinks from years to 3-6 months; speed and iteration become core.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景从数年缩短至 3-6 个月；速度与迭代成为核心。

jennywen.en: Embrace 'cracked new grads' and block-shaped generalists over experienced seniors.
jennywen.zh: 青睐‘天才新毕业生’和块状通才，而非资深专家。

jennywen.en: Designers' value lies in judgment and ambiguity tolerance, not just taste or human-centeredness.
jennywen.zh: 设计师的价值在于判断力和对模糊性的容忍，而非仅品味或以人为本。

jennywen.en: Adopt AI tools cautiously; wait 6 months; focus on users, not hype.
jennywen.zh: 谨慎采用 AI 工具；等待 6 个月；聚焦用户而非炒作。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，我认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 能涌现出上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer learning.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，我强调合成数据的重要性，但需保持熵以避免模型崩溃；人形机器人可从汽车领域迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, prompts are programs; vibe coding democratizes development, but agents need a decade.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我提出软件 3.0：LLM 如操作系统，提示词即程序；氛围编程普及开发，但智能体需十年成熟。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL for LLMs is flawed, synthetic data collapses, cognitive core may be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年末，我认为我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物；LLM 的强化学习有缺陷，合成数据会崩溃，认知核心可能极小。

karpathy.en: I haven't coded since December; agents handle all coding. Bottleneck is directing them, not typing. Understanding remains human.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，我自去年 12 月起不再写代码，全交给智能体；瓶颈在于指挥而非打字，理解仍是人类关键。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码的堆栈；世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car.
kendall.zh: 纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类安全需要雷达和激光雷达；AV 3.0 可能将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem solved with end-to-end learning; scaling requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶本质上是端到端学习解决的 AI 问题；规模化需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 消费级车辆将超越机器人出租车；基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization; safety via minimal risk maneuvers always provides a third option.
kendall.zh: 语言集成改善表示、推理和个性化；通过最小风险操作实现安全，始终提供第三种选择。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素，AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases, not exceptional; only 17% of designers see AI as a threat.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 对成熟代码库的生产力提升有限，并非卓越；仅 17%的设计师视 AI 为威胁。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain critical; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，强调品味、工艺和观点依然关键；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张画布上的直接操作优于提示词调整；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Despite talk of role merging, we see more merging of responsibilities, not roles; human judgment remains essential.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，指出尽管有角色融合的说法，但更多是职责的融合而非角色本身；人类判断依然不可或缺。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling 推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于在真实世界中学习并降低风险（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过 Scaling 预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控助力对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism has increased.
pachocki.zh: 模型将很快能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；对齐乐观情绪上升（2026）。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中（2026）。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿提出 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous. Shift from alignment to freedom.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可地发展，强调控制危险，从对齐转向自由。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is core; next-token prediction lacks a goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他重申强化学习是核心，下一个词预测缺乏目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models too.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他认为学习利于学习的表征是首要开放问题，基于学习模型的规划也是关键。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; AI will render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；AI 将生成自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格把关，产品开发快速推进。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, and model gains.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、功能丰富的产品，而非仅聊天机器人。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems for broad impact, not narrow applications.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题以产生广泛影响，而非狭窄应用。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，认为大语言模型的幻觉在结合真值检测器时可用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to pushing AI beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 年到 2026 年，持续强调后训练结合强化学习是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，指出像代码这样可验证的领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，认为可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may not suffice; new paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年底，我认为 AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上，因为从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升极其困难。仅靠大语言模型可能不够，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluation. Models can regress if labs optimize on wrong data.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年底至 2026 年初，我强调像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被操纵，真正的进展需要深度人工评估。如果实验室基于错误数据优化，模型可能在 6-12 个月内退化。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks; final reward alone is insufficient.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年底至 2026 年初，我提出强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，能模拟真实任务；但仅靠最终奖励是不够的，模型可能以各种方式作弊。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to diverse AIs; eventually every company should train its own models to align with its thesis.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年底至 2026 年初，我认为前沿实验室的目标函数不同，将导致 AI 多样化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以符合其独特理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate, so human judgment is critical; AI tools may cause anchoring and sycophancy, and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年 3 月，在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，因此人类判断至关重要；AI 工具可能导致锚定和谄媚，且不作为（遗漏重要建议）是重大风险。

nando.en: AI should be a tool for all humanity, extending capabilities like microscopes; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths to AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的可行路径。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues in AI; language models can revolutionize local-language education; AI safety is the biggest open challenge.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在 AI 上可跳过遗留问题，语言模型能革新本地语言教育，而 AI 安全是最大未解难题。

nando.en: Consistently champions diversity and inclusion in AI, from community building to global collaboration, as essential for beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 始终倡导 AI 领域的多样性与包容性，从社区建设到全球合作，认为这对有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: Shifted from technical optimism about scaling and generalist agents to emphasizing responsible deployment and safety as critical priorities.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年对 Scaling 和通用智能体的技术乐观，转向 2026 年强调负责任部署与安全为关键优先事项。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升智能。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is key; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with agents improving via RL.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，智能体也能通过强化学习提升能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator; agents will automate white-collar jobs by 2027-2028, but reliability is the bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为编程是 AI 进步的领先指标；到 2027-2028 年智能体将自动化白领工作，但可靠性是门槛。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (30h) expands achievements; progress is exponential, not plateauing.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出强化学习是新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）大幅扩展成就；进展是指数级的，而非停滞。

sholto.en: Capability overhang: tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; future work is managing agent teams.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为存在能力过剩：工具和编排比原始智能更重要；未来工作是管理智能体团队。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI is a creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴；代码是唯一真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and leverage AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图而非流程；副项目可超越传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；不采用如同忽视早期互联网。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 可能无法解决常识问题；拥有更好数据和算法的小模型可以超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我始终强调数据是根本瓶颈，当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我认为强化学习需要精细工程；RLVR 可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 提升。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观多样性，并认为消除互联网偏见不可行。

yejin.en: Small models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; RL during pre-training improves reasoning.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我认为小模型配合多样合成数据可变得强大，预训练中的强化学习能提升推理。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加快交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy is a dynamic platform for expression and a recruiting tool; invest early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌策略是表达与招聘的动态平台；尽早投入以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow and collaborate.
henrymodisett.zh: 招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权与自主权以促进成长与协作。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic, on-demand feedback to maintain velocity and decisiveness.
henrymodisett.zh: 避免结构化设计评审；偏好有机、按需反馈以保持速度与决断力。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; velocity and iteration beat perfection in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；在快速成长的初创公司中，速度与迭代胜过完美。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents require root-cause analysis for productivity.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言优先考虑 AI 生成的可验证性；编码智能体需根因分析以提升生产力。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：客户体验 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本将大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to agents, not humans; incumbents face business model challenges; generalists outperform specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体将与智能体而非人类比较；现有企业面临商业模式挑战；通才胜过专才。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute may surpass pre-training scaling as next driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律预测进展；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练 Scaling 成为下一驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会是主要编程方式；示例和直接操作更好。

truell.en: Agents promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体有前景但尚不实用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design become key.
truell.zh: 编程从代码转向意图描述；品味和逻辑设计成为关键。

truell.en: Custom models essential for product quality; every magic moment involves custom model.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要；每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox, shifting engineers from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin are best used as junior engineers with human oversight, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，他提出像 Devin 这样的 AI 编码智能体最适合作为初级工程师，在人类监督下处理明确任务，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Enterprise AI adoption requires trust and permissions; full autonomy is not yet feasible.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调企业采用 AI 需要信任和权限设置，完全自主尚不可行。

scottwu.en: AGI will arrive gradually, not suddenly; freezing models would still yield a decade of product innovation.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他认为 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变；即使冻结模型，产品创新仍可延续十年。

scottwu.en: Value accrues across the entire AI stack; all layers (datacenter, labs, apps) will benefit.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他指出 AI 价值分布在整条技术栈，数据中心、实验室和应用层都将受益。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields smarter AI, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，我认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备的；通过算力和数据扩展能获得更智能的 AI，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models should learn by acting, not just passive data.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，我强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇；模型应通过行动学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，我认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单独无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; AGI is underhyped economically, coding is underhyped for self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我指出开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距；AGI 的经济影响被低估，编码在自我加速中被低估。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research and talent; alignment and robustness are key; PhD is best path.
leike.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全需要实证研究和人才，对齐与鲁棒性是关键，读博是成为安全研究者的最佳路径。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; scalable oversight and interpretability are needed; alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我提出 RLHF 无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient; external oversight and raising misuse cost are vital.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我认为 OpenAI 的安全文化已退化，仅靠后训练不足以解决对齐，需要外部监管，并提高滥用成本以争取时间。
